text: Who was Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, and what did Allah give him?
He was the son of Prophet Dawud, alayhis salaam, the king of Bani Israil. Allah says: "And to Dawud We gave Sulaiman. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back to Allah."
Allah tells us of a case they judged: a people's sheep had gone into a field at night and eaten its crop.
Prophet Dawud, alayhis salaam, judged, and Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, judged too.
And Allah says: "We gave understanding of the case to Sulaiman, and to each of them We gave judgement and knowledge."
Understanding from Allah: that was the first gift. It would not be the last.
